summary: The focused claim o-6a0b5efd83350fe9 remains unresolved: both versions reject the harness’s document-node argument if its doc field is null, but the supplied parser path does not establish that field’s value.
missing_information: How parser.c::xmlDoRead constructs the document returned by xmlCtxtReadMemory, including the returned document node’s doc field.

assessment.necessity_reason: The same old harness passes its parsed document to xmlXIncludeProcessNode on both sides. Whether that call reaches DOM processing depends on the document node’s unestablished doc field.

before.requirement: A valid parsed document containing an include must reach DOM XInclude processing through the harness’s document-node call.
before.reason: xmlXIncludeProcessNode rejects node->doc == NULL. xmlCtxtReadMemory delegates creation of the returned document to xmlDoRead, whose behavior is not supplied.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser entry delegates construction of the document passed to XInclude processing to xmlDoRead.
The guarded call reaches this processing root only if its document-node argument passes the entry guard.

after.requirement: The same valid parsed document must reach DOM XInclude processing through the same document-node call.
after.reason: The guard is unchanged, and the supplied after parser entry still delegates document construction to xmlDoRead.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The after parser entry also delegates construction of the document passed to XInclude processing to xmlDoRead.
Change g0044 alters memory-error reporting in the processing root, while the document-node entry guard remains the decisive condition for this claim.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness also invokes a reader, but that call does not establish the outcome of its explicit DOM document-node call.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same argument and guard apply before and after. The missing document-construction fact prevents establishing whether either side is blocked.
missing_information: The doc field of a valid document returned by parser.c::xmlDoRead under the harness’s options.
